name: dirty-ownership-oracle
title: Classify dirty worktree paths for TEST and DONE gates
description: Field report B-c9f5 on 2026-05-15 showed a REVIEW/TEST loop where Koala validation evidence and generated product output were both reported as generic dirty worktree failure. The current DONE gate uses raw git status and cannot distinguish Koala-owned story metadata, runtime artifacts, declared delivery artifacts, source or fixture changes, and unexpected dirty files. Build a typed dirty ownership oracle first so later lifecycle gates can report and enforce the right category without scattering ad hoc path checks across story_advance, validate, and session output.
